title: Best AI Tools for Businesses in Indonesia (2026): Bahasa AI, Gojek Ecosystem & E-Commerce
excerpt: Indonesia's digital economy is projected to reach $130B by 2030 — already the largest in Southeast Asia with 210M internet users, 6 unicorns, and 64M MSMEs. author: Apifeny AI Team
content: Indonesia AI market overview, best AI tools for Bahasa Indonesia support including Gemini vs ChatGPT vs IndoBERT, PPN 11% tax compliance with Jurnal Mekari and OnlinePajak, WhatsApp Business API automation with WATI and Kata.ai, e-commerce tools for Tokopedia/Shopee/TikTok Shop via Sirclo, marketing with Canva Indonesia and Sociolla, productivity with Mekari and Qontak, UU PDP data privacy compliance, and industry-specific recommendations for Jakarta startups, retail/e-commerce, manufacturing, fintech, healthtech, and agriculture across the archipelago.
